svg.title: How Chelsea reached 2–0
svg.desc: Everton and Chelsea were level at half-time. Pedro Neto made it 0–1 in the 46th minute and 0–2 in the 90th; the final score was 0–2. Official goal minutes: 46 and 90. Half-time and full-time mark match stages; added time is not shown to scale. Source: Chelsea's official match report.
